global.title: India’s satcom market is ready for scale as regulation, pricing and use cases align
global.summary: India is entering a decisive decade for satellite communications. The market has long been shaped by enterprises, government and broadcast demand, but constrained by limited capacity, high service costs and narrow deployment models. That equation is changing as high-throughput geostationary orbit (GEO) satellites expand, non-GEO constellations prepare for commercial entry and connectivity resilience becomes a strategic requirement across public and private networks.
